summary: The worker correctly noticed that the P10 completion used full_archive=NO instead of the current full_archive_decision=YES|NO contract. Admin review found a deeper root cause: P9 had been claimed before the new P9-PLAYBACK-GATE dependency was introduced, then completed afterward at 0/60, and P10 was subsequently completed from that premature P9 state. P9-PLAYBACK-GATE never existed.
impact: The substantive NO recommendation was safe, but the authoritative workflow state was wrong: P9/P10 appeared completed before the current mandatory playback gate chain had passed.

actions: Preserved both original completion records under coordination/invalidated/ as historical snapshots.
Removed premature P9-AUDIT-60 and P10-PILOT-DECISION records from coordination/completed/.
Removed their obsolete grandfather claims so the tasks can be freshly claimed only after current dependencies are satisfied.
The correct future P10 contract requires full_archive_decision=YES|NO when P10 is legitimately rerun after a valid P9 completion.
resolution.authoritative_next_path: real playback evidence -> audit_gate pass -> P9-PLAYBACK-GATE -> fresh P9-AUDIT-60 -> fresh P10-PILOT-DECISION

worker_action: Reported only. No control-plane or completed-task file was modified by the worker.
